user.title: Find your property
user.description: Type the start of your street address, for example "3 Parsons". The council only lists properties in the Toowoomba Region.

select.title: Select your property
select.description: Pick your address from the council's list. If it isn't shown, go back and type more of the address.

error.no_results: The council has no property matching that address.
error.no_collection: The council has no waste collection for that property.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Toowoomba Regional Council service. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This property is already set up.
